text:
anya: Quick heads-up — doing a spiral micro-bump rollout for feature-x today at 16:00 UTC. Minimal user impact plan: small incremental audience bumps rather than one big canary. Need: deployer, smoke owners, rollback ready.
kevin: Sounds good. Suggested staircase: 0.5% -> 1.5% -> 3% -> 7% -> 15% final. Wait 10m between first two, 15-20m for later steps.
sam: Agree with timing. Are we targeting US first only?
tina: I can do the deploy and stay on the thread. Targeting US regions only for the first pass. Will open the staging -> prod rollout in infra console at 16:00.
sre-oncall: Smoke checklist I’ll watch: 1) p95 latency for /generate and /chat 2) 5xx rate by route 3) model fallback rate (kv-cache misses) 4) GPU queue depth and pod CPU/mem 5) billing token anomalies. Thresholds: p95 > baseline*1.3 or errors > 0.5% absolute => call rollback.
maria: Feature-flag key? Need the kill switch link and who has perms to flip.
kevin: Feature flag key is ff.feature_x.spiral. Ops role (tina, sam) + eng-release leads can flip. Kill switch command: `ffctl disable ff.feature_x.spiral --env prod --reason "rollback"`
ops-bot: deploy-triggered: infra deploy feature-x --tag spiral-203912 --env prod (scheduled by tina at 16:00 UTC) :rocket:
anya: Tina — when you kick off, post the infra job id here. Sam/kevin, please prestage the post-merge manifest diff (image + ff flag).
tina: infra job id: 84721. Pushing image `redwood/feature-x:spiral-203912` now. Run command I’ll use: ```infra deploy --service feature-x --image redwood/feature-x:spiral-203912 --env prod --strategy gradual```
sam: I’ll post the manifest diff in the PR and keep an eye on release blockers.
sre-oncall: I’ll open a small dashboard and alert quietly for the next 90m. If I see error spikes or p95 jumps above threshold, I’ll ping and request stop.
maria: Also confirm A/B cohort selection: backend will route based on shard header; first 0.5% will be a geo-distributed random bucket, not only new users. Can we scope to logged-in only in step 3+?
kevin: Good call — scope to logged-in starting at the 3% step. I already added that rule to rollout config.
tina: Kicked off stage -> prod sync. First bump scheduled at 16:10 UTC (post smoke). I’ll manually advance at each step after SRE 👍.
anya: Thanks. Post here at each step with metrics: p50/p95 latency, 5xx%, fallback rate, and any errors. If no objections I’ll mark this as green to proceed. :thumbsup:
kevin: +1
sam: +1
sre-oncall: Watching now — will ping on any violations.
tina: 0.5% live. infra job 84721 finished. Observability links: https://dashboards.internal/redwood/feature-x (watching p95 panel)
sre-oncall: Seeing small increase in tail latency (p95 +8%) but error flat. Holding till 16:25 to validate.
anya: Hold noted. Proceed to 1.5% only if p95 stays < baseline*1.15.
tina: Understood. Will not advance until SRE gives thumbs up.
ops-bot: reminder scheduled: rollback window ends at 18:30 UTC.
kevin: If we need fast rollback: `infra rollback --service feature-x --to-tag stable-202912 --env prod` (should restore traffic within ~90s).
anya: Perfect. Final note: please add short post-rollout thread with final metrics and any lessons. Thanks team.
